articles.title: Arch Manning shares emotional hug with dad after last-second touchdown seals dramatic Texas win
articles.summary: Arch Manning experienced just about every emotion a quarterback can feel in a college football game on Saturday. He threw three interceptions, watched Texas fall behind LSU and endured a frustrating night against a fierce opponent. But when the Longhorns needed him most, the highly touted quarterback delivered — and the emotions finally caught up with him. Moments after throwing the game-winning touchdown with just three seconds remaining to secure a dramatic 22-21 victory over LSU, Manning embraced his father, Cooper Manning, on the field. The emotional hug captured the significance of a comeback that required the young quarterback to overcome one of the most difficult performances of his college career. It was a moment of relief, pride and emotion after a roller-coaster night in which Manning went from struggling to becoming the hero of Austin.

articles.title: Music festival descends into chaos as massive brawl erupts on famous Mexican beach
articles.summary: A night of music and entertainment at Acapulco’s Tonic Fest ended in chaos after a massive brawl broke out among attendees, with chairs flying, people throwing punches and dozens of concertgoers caught up in a confrontation that brought the event to an ugly end. Videos circulating on social media captured the chaotic scenes at Playa Tamarindos, in Acapulco, southern Mexico, where groups of people could be seen punching and shoving one another as chairs and other objects lay scattered across the venue. Several attendees attempted to intervene and separate those involved, but the situation quickly escalated into a massive melee. According to eyewitness accounts, the trouble began after rapper Santa Fe Klan invited people waiting outside the concert area to enter the venue from the stage. Dozens of people reportedly knocked down security barriers and stormed the concert area, triggering confusion and confrontations among attendees.

The Red Bulls secured a 1-0 victory at Sports Illustrated Stadium in New Jersey, but the result quickly became an afterthought after tempers boiled over in the 85th minute. A late confrontation near the end line escalated into an all-out melee, with players from both teams abandoning the soccer match to exchange punches, kicks and shoves. It began as an isolated altercation but it rapidly spread across the pitch, forcing officials and members of both coaching staffs to intervene as they attempted to separate the players.
